name: Savior
source:
In Savior, you take on the role of a man who was genetically engineered by his scientist parents due to infertility. However, our hero hides a big secret inside of his genetic code.

With the world in great peril, it is up to our hero to discover the secrets hidden within his blood and awaken the great potential lying dormant within.
Along the way, our hero will encounter many hot new... acquaintances. Will they be friends or foes? Will they do battle, or will they be doing each other from dusk until dawn? The choice is yours! Be sure to choose wisely, because you are...The savior.

[From [url=https://purple-fellas.itch.io/savior]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《Savior》中，你将扮演一名由科学家父母通过基因工程创造出的男子，因为他们无法自然生育。然而，在这位主人公的遗传密码中，还隐藏着一个重大的秘密。

世界危在旦夕，主人公必须揭开自己血脉中的秘密，唤醒体内沉睡的巨大潜能。
一路上，他还会结识许多火辣的新……熟人。她们会是朋友，还是敌人？彼此之间会展开战斗，还是从黄昏到黎明缠绵不休？选择权在你！务必谨慎决定，因为你就是……救世主。

[摘自[url=https://purple-fellas.itch.io/savior]itch.io[/url]]
